Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/

We look forward to your application!

Above Benchmark is one of Australia’s leading Mystery Shopping Providers. Due to recent growth and new client partners, we are now recruiting Mystery Shoppers in numerous cities and regional towns across Australia.  
   

CURRENT OPENING:  

We are looking for a Mystery Shopper who owns a dog or cat and can take their pet to a vet for a consultation. Payment for this survey is $30, PLUS you will be reimbursed for the consult fee up to $130. These are great surveys for pet owners and are especially suitable for annual vaccinations or a general health check-up.  

You will be provided instructions and a survey form for each job, then simply visit the target client and act just like a regular customer, while observing everything. Upon completion, you log into our Mystery Shopping software and enter the results including any required photos and receipts.   
  

TO JOIN OUR TEAM YOU WILL NEED;  

  • regular and reliable access to the internet, email and a ideally a printer  

  • an excellent memory and report writing skills  

  • confidence to role-play and improvise  

  • fantastic communication skills; verbal and written  

  • confidence in computers/smartphones, etc.  
  

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. It’s very casual and you apply for the mystery shops that you're interested in doing. Full instructions are provided along with any specific requirements, deadlines and full details if you need to purchase something.    
   

PAY STRUCTURE:  

Mystery Shop payments are different for each job and are based on the time needed to perform the Mystery Shop. Mystery Shop payments range from $15 - $30 for phone calls and $20 -$50 for onsite visits. Meals and purchases are in addition to the mystery shop payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers are paid back with their survey payment.   

At Above Benchmark we are incredibly proud to say we have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country with pays being processed weekly.  


PAYMENT REQUIREMENTS:  

Mystery Shoppers are typically independent contractors, not employees. They can invoice us with an ABN or they can choose to complete a simple form from the ATO stating they are undertaking Mystery Shopping as a Hobby. Mystery Shoppers are not required to supply a TFN and are responsible for their own superannuation, tax and insurance.  

  
ABOUT US:  

Above Benchmark is a member of the Mystery Shopper Professional Association in the Asia-Pacific region ensuring we adhere to a strict code of conduct policy. We have over 2 decades of experience, happy clients in almost every industry and thousands of professional mystery shoppers on our team. We help small businesses grow, help big businesses remain industry leaders and provide casual and flexible work opportunities to those looking to boost their income.  

   
HOW TO APPLY:  

If you meet the above criteria and would like to apply to join our team, please visit our website for more details, informative blogs and Mystery Shopper testimonials. Our confidential application form can be found here:   http://www.abovebenchmark.com.au/become-a-shopper/   

Thank you for considering our Mystery Shopping position. We look forward to your application!

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments.
